description: Memeriksa struktur dan CRC QRIS. Validates a QRIS payload: TLV structure, mandatory fields, value formats and the CRC-16/CCITT (init 0xFFFF) checksum. Reports every problem found (errors and warnings) with a code and a fix hint. Offline.

qris.description: The QRIS payload text (starts with "000201" and ends with "6304" + 4 hex characters). Paste text, not an image.

name: validate_qris
title: Validasi QRIS / Validate QRIS
